https://lars147.github.io/foldroute/

FoldRoute - a PWA route planer for folding bikes & public transport

I bought a Brompton a few months ago and realized there is no good planer for combining biking and public transport. I one-shotted the first approach with codex. It was so decent that I wanted to elaborate on the idea. Still not perfect and needs a lot of testing in the wild (especially the navigation). Currently, only in German. If there is demand, I will translate to English. For now only a PWA. Therefore, it has some limitations. Maybe I will make it an Android / iOS app one day.
